title: Solid build and components working together
summary: Reviews in this topic center on the G60 feeling well assembled and solid, while many other fragments use "together" in unrelated or ambiguous ways that do not clearly express sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise solid construction, upscale feel, and smooth combined power delivery from hybrid components.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly too brief or context-poor, though several mention the car feeling well put together or describe unrelated uses of "together."

limitations: This cluster mixes clear build-quality comments with unrelated uses of the word "together," such as service interactions, accessories, cupholders, and hybrid system descriptions.
Most fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the evidence is limited for drawing a tighter thematic summary.
